details:
Add a "Multi-Group" instance privacy type that allows instance creators to select multiple specific groups from a list. Only members of the selected groups (and optionally their friends in a "+" variant) would be allowed to join the instance.

Currently, group instances are limited to single-group access (Group, Group+, Group Public). When hosting cross-community events, collaborative parties, or joint group activities, creators are forced to either:

- Use a Group Public instance, which opens the world to everyone and removes privacy/moderation control.

- Rely on Friends+ / Invite+ instances, requiring attendees to manually add hosts or moderators as friends.

Proposed Solution:

- When a user with instance creation permissions opens the instance creation menu, add a Multi-Group option:

- Group Selection List: A menu listing only the groups where the user is both a member AND holds instance-creation permissions.

- Selection Mechanism: Checkboxes allowing the host to select two or more specific groups for that instance.

-Access Rules:

  - Multi-Group: Only members of the selected groups can join.

  - Multi-Group+: Members of the selected groups AND their friends can join.

Benefits:

- Streamlines cross-group and multi-community events without losing privacy control.

- Eliminates the need to send individual friend requests or spam invites for joint events.

- Enhances safety by keeping event access restricted strictly to verified members of partner communities.
title: Multi-Group Instance Access (Selected Groups Only)
